Overhauls federal permitting processes by introducing standardized digital workflows, cloud-based portals, automated tools, and AI-supported data management.

card.summary: The ePermit Act requires the Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) and federal agencies to digitize, standardize, and modernize environmental reviews and authorizations under the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969. It establishes data standards, prototype tools, minimum functional requirements, and a unified interagency data system that includes a shared cloud-based authorization portal for project sponsors, federal agencies, and the public.
